text:
noah-devx: Weird parity break: curl to /v1/embeddings?partial_ok=true works but SDK option partialOk gets a 400. Quickstart CI failing.

ren-sdks: which SDK/version and snippet?

noah-devx: js SDK 1.8.1.
```
# REST
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?partial_ok=true\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $T\" -d '{"model":"mini-embed","inputs":["short","long text...","errorish"]}'
```
JS: 
```js
client.embeddings.create({ model: 'mini-embed', inputs: ['short','long text','errorish'], partialOk: true })
```
REST: 200 + partials for failing items. SDK: 400 "unknown parameter: partialOk".

ivy-samples: our onboarding quickstart CI started failing when we pushed batched examples. It's blocking new users.

tara-api: server historically accepted snake_case query params like partial_ok. We intentionally tolerate both snake and camel in query parsing, but body validation is stricter and the SDK serializer is sending the flag in the JSON body as partialOk which our validation rejects.

ren-sdks: sounds like two fixes: 1) SDK should accept camelCase aliases and map to server query param for batch endpoints; 2) retry behavior is inconsistent: REST returns standard Retry-After on 429 but the SDK only looked at x-retry-ms. Saw retry storms in staging.

noah-devx: exactly. When SDK retries too fast our CI hits rate limits repeatedly which surfaces as flakes.

ren-sdks: plan: update param normalization to emit partial_ok in query if client option present, add camelCase aliases for known flags, and update retry middleware to prefer Retry-After header then fallback to x-retry-ms. Add unit tests + a tiny integration smoke that diffs curl vs SDK on status and top-level keys.

tara-api: we'll keep emitting both headers for a release window. Also can add a compatibility test on the server to catch strict filters turning on unexpectedly.

ci-bot: Branch created: fix/sdk-query-flag-and-retry-headers (#3501) by ren-sdks  CI queued.

ivy-samples: once merged I'll bump quickstart and re-run CI. Can you add a short changelog note for the SDK so users know camelCase flags are now tolerated?

ren-sdks: will add CHANGELOG: "JS SDK v1.8.2: tolerate camelCase flags for query options, normalize to server params, and respect standard Retry-After headers."

noah-devx: also suggest adding a tiny sample smoke test in samples/ci that runs a curl vs SDK shape check for embeddings/generate — caught subtle drift before.

ren-sdks: +1. I'll add a lightweight script that checks status and top-level keys only so it stays stable.

ivy-samples: thanks team, this will unblock onboarding.

noah-devx: thanks! :tada:
